question: Why feed probabilities into a stacking model?
quick: Probabilities preserve uncertainty that hard class votes discard.
standard:
Probabilities preserve uncertainty that hard class votes discard.

soft_features flattens model-by-class probability vectors into per-sample features. hard_features one-hot encodes argmax predictions. enhanced_features adds confidence, entropy and pairwise agreement. The module provides several learned combiners and voting baselines.
deep:
Probabilities preserve uncertainty that hard class votes discard.

soft_features flattens model-by-class probability vectors into per-sample features. hard_features one-hot encodes argmax predictions. enhanced_features adds confidence, entropy and pairwise agreement. The module provides several learned combiners and voting baselines.

Train combiners on predictions from held-out or out-of-fold data, never on in-sample base-model predictions. Validate probability shape, finite values and row sums. A powerful meta-model can otherwise learn training artifacts and appear better without generalizing.
mistake: Training and evaluating a combiner on leaked predictions.
